propositions: A transient git fetch timeout (300s stall) from the GitHub mirror is caught as SnapshotFetchError and converted to a durable LLM-Review -1 vote that suppresses backfill reconciliation
The review bot's adapter.code_review_decision blanket exception handler cannot distinguish infrastructure faults from genuine review conclusions, routing all exceptions to a fail-closed BLOCK verdict
Once a spurious -1 vote is cast, reconcile.py pre-filters on has_llm_review_vote and skips the change forever, removing it from backfill safety net recovery
Retryable infrastructure exceptions (SnapshotFetchError, subprocess.TimeoutExpired, TimeoutError, ConnectionError) should return an ABSTAIN result that posts no vote and writes no dedup row
An abstained change must remain vote-less so backfill reconciliation re-drives it on the next pass instead of being permanently suppressed by a durable -1
